description: Read-only. Reads `latestTierId()` then `getTierViews(0, latestTierId)` on the DAO's TokenSaleProposal: tiers with `totalSold` and status (`upcoming`/`active`/`ended`/`off`) computed from the current block timestamp and the tier's on-chain isOff flag. On-chain only — any chain with an RPC; the reply echoes the resolved `chainId`. `tokenSaleProposal` defaults to the address this install's local state records for the DAO; otherwise it is required.

chainId.description: Chain to read from: 56 mainnet, 97 testnet. Needs an RPC for it. Default: the configured chain.

tokenSaleProposal.description: TokenSaleProposal helper address. Omit when the local state records it; otherwise dexe_dao_predict_addresses or the deploy receipt.

name: dexe_read_token_sales
title: List a DAO's token sale tiers
